Earlier [0] I mentioned that I am dealing with integration of functions defined on the standard simplex $E^{k-1}$ embedded in $R^k$. I presented then a draft of a package for coordinate Lebesgue measure on the standard simplex and its affine hull. Now I have added codes for Dirichlet measure on the standard simplex. Perhaps these codes would be of interest for inclusion in the ProbabilityTheory section of Mathlib as an extension of the two-variable BetaDistribution that is there already. The project is not done and I would welcome feedback before revising it further for submission to Mathlib.

Both codes, the LebesgueMeasure and the DirichletMeasure are in this folder: https://github.com/bjbraams/lean-codes/. The newer Dirichlet package is this file: https://github.com/bjbraams/lean-codes/blob/main/StdSimplexMeasure/DirichletMeasure.lean.

As said, I would welcome further advice. In this work I have relied extensively on interaction with various LLM. The outermost design is mine, but all proofs were developed by LLM, foremost by ChatGPT 5.6.

[0] https://leanprover.zulipchat.com/#narrow/channel/116395-maths/topic/Lebesgue.20measure.20on.20the.20multidimensional.20standard.20simplex/with/617157493
